ShortDescription.Value: Unlock Signature buildings, place multiple Unique buildings, and control city-wide and nearby bonuses.

Publish.LongDescription:
# 🏙️ ### Realistic Signature Buildings Fix #### Place unlimited buildings without breaking the city's economy!
**随心建造多个特色建筑，同时避免城市经济失衡！**
Duplicate Unique and Signature buildings can stack powerful city-wide bonuses, making CS2's economy too easy.
### 1. Control Unique + Signature city-wide bonuses
* **Vanilla Stacking:** every copy has all normal bonuses (game default). Want super-easy mode? Keep stacking! * **First Copy Only**: only one copy of each Unique or Signature building type adds city-wide bonuses (where available). More Realistic, 5 copies no longer has 5x stacked bonuses! * **No City Bonuses:** disable general city-wide bonuses from Unique and Signature buildings.
**City-wide Attractiveness is controlled separately for eligible Unique and Signature buildings.** Choose First copy only (default), Vanilla stacking, No bonus, or Follow city-wide setting.
### 2. Nearby Local Effects — Separate controls!
* Keep neighborhood "aoe" benefits w/out stacking multiplying whole city bonuses! * Choose **Vanilla, First-Copy Only, or Off** independent of your city-wide bonus setting.
### 3. More Options - You choose!
* ✅ Allow Unlimited Unique buildings — base game, DLC, Region Packs, and compatible custom assets marked Unique by the game. * ✅ Unlock Signature buildings without meeting their requirements. Other Unique service buildings still need Development points. * ✅ QoL, Hide mass unlock pop-ups: Stop the spam when unlocking many at once. Save your click finger! * ✅ See Clearly: prevent blacked-out buildings and colored overlays while placing Unique buildings. You can still open the infoview panel manually.
### Compatibility
* Compatible with **Anarchy**, including its multiple unique setting. * Safe to remove: placed copies stay; vanilla bonuses and placement rules return after restart. No Harmony patches, vanilla methods.
### Important
* Hover over Options menu rows for tool tips (see the 3rd panel). * Note about a building's green bonus text: the info panel always shows the original bonus details, even when this mod reduces or disables those bonuses. This is only a display limitation — the actual bonuses are controlled correctly. Check Options → Actions → Status or use the About tab → Status report buttons to verify details.
## Support and Feedback
* Support by clicking Like (top right), no donations requested, just a like for many days of work. * For feedback, use the [Discord](https://discord.gg/gwXgvtyhjc) | [GitHub](https://github.com/River-Mochi/CS2-RealisticSignature) links on this page. PRs are welcome, GPL-3.0 license.
### Languages
English, Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Polski, Português (Brasil), Português (Portugal), Türkçe, ไทย, Tiếng Việt, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文
### Credits
* RiverMochi: mod author and maintainer * Thumbnail of the 8House in Copenhagen by Bjarke Ingels [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/8_House), CC license photo by Jens Lindhe. * UnhingedWolf: testing and feedback

**自由建造多个独特建筑，同时避免重复加成破坏城市经济平衡！**
* **全市加成：** 默认每种独特或标志性建筑只计算一栋的加成，避免重复叠加。也可选择原版叠加或关闭全市加成。
* **城市吸引力：** 可单独设置，默认每种符合条件的建筑只计算一栋的吸引力加成。
* **周边效果：** 默认保留所有建筑的正常区域效果，也可选择仅保留一栋或全部关闭。
* **自由建造：** 默认允许重复建造游戏认定的独特建筑，包括本体、DLC、地区建筑包和兼容的自定义资产。
* **解锁建筑：** 可跳过标志性建筑的解锁条件。其他独特公共服务建筑仍需使用发展点数解锁。
* **界面优化：** 可隐藏大量解锁弹窗，以及放置独特建筑时自动出现的地图信息覆盖层。
**重要提示：** 建筑信息面板中的绿色加成文字仍会显示原版数值，即使模组已限制或关闭该加成。**这只是显示上的限制，不代表模组失效。** 可在模组选项的“操作 → 状态”中查看，或通过日志报告确认实际效果。
**兼容 Anarchy，无需 Harmony 补丁。** 移除模组不会删除已建造的建筑副本。
